description: The second half of the mirror clause, and the half that would have been wrong quietly. `not reached yet` is only honest about an environment the running cycle is actually going to touch: a deploy to stage says nothing whatever about prod, and a map that told every prod node to expect figures would have replaced one false sentence with a louder one. The environment list is the dashboard's, handed over with the observation rather than re-derived here - one definition, one host. A COMPLETED run is not under way anywhere, which is the same rule figuresAreOlder() applies for the opposite purpose.
